answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 3801 Country: India Title: My question is how far it is from sunnat to put our hands below the nawal during salaah(Namaaz)I need strong proof with reference please write me. Question: My question is how far it is from sunnat to put our hands below the nawal during salaah(Namaaz)I need strong proof with reference please write me. Answer ID: 3801 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 73/73=M) It is Sunnah to put the hands below navels during salah and this is proved by several traditions. In Abu Dawood it is narrated by Hazrat Ali ( رضی اللہ عنہ ): السنۃ وضع الکف علی الکف فی الصلاۃ تحت السرۃ Hazrat Alqamah bin Waail bin Hajar narrates from his father: ر أ یت النبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم وضع یمینہ علی شمالہ فی الصلاۃ تحت السرۃ، أخرجہ ابن أبی شیبۃ ورجالہ ثقات ، وقال الشیخ قاسم بن قطلوبغا الحنفی: ان ھذا سند جید اھ شرح الترمذی ل أبی الطیب رحمہ اللہ ( اعلاء السنن: 2/166،171 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
